analysis.scope: Analytical bounds with explicit unqualified inputs; not SPICE, silicon characterization or a bench result.

unqualified: Effective capacitor bounds include provisional tolerance, temperature, bias and aging allowances; validate actual selected MPN curves.
The 0.6/1.4 timer scaling extrapolates TPS3808 specified timing endpoints to these capacitors; it is a design assumption, not a new manufacturer guarantee.
Confirm that every fault capable of disabling the modem fully resets CT; SENSE propagation and minimum fault width are typical-only in the datasheet.
Bound the declared ENABLE/SENSE input loads and POWER_GOOD high drop over voltage and temperature.
The 6-ohm hot FET allowance and switch/LDO turnoff latency require characterization; room-temperature RDS and typical propagation do not establish them.
Static cutoff is not an energy reserve. Verify source impedance and hold-up for the calculated shutdown interval; abrupt collapse can outrun sequencing.
Check partial startup, very short faults, rapid rebound, depleted-cell charge recovery and charger removal with the actual cell and loads.
Select and qualify protected pack/NTC, capacitor and resistor AVL, charging protection, RF and factory programming/test.
Firmware must keep GPIOs inactive until VIO is valid and recover I2C after a restart; configure the actual cell model and do not quick-start on every MCU reset.
